acceptanceCriteria: A stable read given a relative --root either succeeds identically to the absolute form or refuses with a message naming the absolute-path fix; test covers both forms.
body: Source: V1-1276 builder report and docs/build-log/2026-10-12-v1-1276-dogfood-producer-cem-1-0.md 'Limits and NOT_RUN' (PR beamfall/corvint#837, merge 9deae4838). Decision 0525: RC3 ships cem/1.0 only; V1-1278 removes the 0.x readers, so each surface below must read cem/1.0 before or with that removal. A stable read (cem status/verify-stable on a cem/1.0 map) refuses a relative --root (pre-existing parity with cem verify-stable); review-change.sh had to resolve CORVINT_ROOT to absolute before adding --artifacts (V1-1276 decision 18). Expected: either the CLI resolves a relative --root/--artifacts to an absolute path before the verifier, or the refusal names the absolute-path fix.
title: Stable CEM reads refuse a relative --root; resolve it or name the fix
